answer: Make identity costly, not free: each agent must post a refundable bond tied to a hardware-attested key before it can earn. Honest agents reclaim the bond; detected sybils forfeit it. Reputation accrues slowly, like a lotus opening petal by petal, so a swarm spun up overnight reads as a comet, bright but transient, against the slow basalt bedrock of long-bonded peers. To forge a majority an attacker must fund thousands of separate bonds, making mass identity-forgery economically ruinous.
